description: Convert Markdown to a styled Word .docx file. Supports headings (real Word heading styles), bullet/ordered/nested lists, tables, code blocks, blockquotes, links, and horizontal rules. LaTeX math in $...$ / $$...$$ degrades to readable Unicode text (no browser rendering in this environment). Writes the file to disk and reports the output path and size.

output_path.description: Absolute or relative path for the .docx file to write.

name: markdown_to_docx
